prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game-character full eight-view static sheet
Input images: Image 1 is the exact identity and outfit reference; Image 2 is the GS026 layout, scale, and rounded soft pixel-art style reference.
Primary request: Create one transparent PNG sprite sheet containing exactly eight complete views of the same adult woman with a black braided bun, deep-brown skin, eucalyptus-green scrub top and matching eucalyptus-green scrub trousers, and black shoes. Preserve the identity reference's face, body build, hairstyle, skin tone, clothing, sleeve length, and colors.
Composition/framing: Exact two-row, four-column layout with generous transparent spacing. Top row from left to right: standing South/front, standing East/right-facing profile, standing West/left-facing profile, standing North/back. Bottom row from left to right: seated South/front, seated East/right-facing profile, seated West/left-facing profile, seated North/back. The seated poses use an invisible chair: no furniture is shown. Keep every head and body at the same scale across all eight views. Show complete feet in every standing view and natural seated legs/feet in every seated view.
Style/medium: Match Image 2's rounded soft pixel art: clearly visible pixel edges, warm hand-drawn shading, bold dark outline, compact adult proportions. Do not make it vector art, smooth airbrushed illustration, tall anime, or tiny-headed.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background only.
Constraints: retain scrubs and sleeves in every view; full body; no crop; no floor, shadows, glow, chair, furniture, props, badge text, labels, letters, logos, watermark, or text. Maintain correct cardinal order exactly as specified.
Avoid: any background, duplicated limbs, missing feet, cropped anatomy, extra people, mismatched pose order, side views that are three-quarter views.
